result.title: AutoAssumption: Searching over Assumptions Discovers ML-Systems Algorithms
result.comment: 52 pages (9 main + references and appendix), 14 figures, 13 tables
result.summary: Many advances in ML systems came from breaking an assumption that earlier methods took for granted: speculative decoding dropped the assumption that a model needs one forward pass per token. Yet algorithms rarely state their assumptions, so experts and discovery harnesses search over programs, where one edit changes several design choices and gains are difficult to attribute. Searching over the assumptions themselves remains largely unexplored. Writing algorithms as proofs makes their assumptions explicit and turns algorithm design into a search over a small, structured space that an LLM can explore and a proof checker can audit. We formalize 89 algorithms from KV-cache eviction, weight pruning and speculative decoding as proof graphs with explicit assumptions, checked in Lean. Our harness, AutoAssumption, relaxes one assumption of a published method, re-derives and re-proves it, and generates its code. In KV-cache eviction and weight pruning, this search improved on every published algorithm we ran and produced state-of-the-art algorithms. The eviction algorithm has the highest RULER-4K score of the published methods we ran, and the pruning algorithm the lowest perplexity of thirteen on four LLaMA models. At equal budget, the harness scores within a point of OpenEvolve, an open-source implementation of AlphaEvolve, with a lower standard deviation across repeats. Future work will formalize more fields and combine them through the principal assumptions they share.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把 89 个 ML 系统算法（KV-cache 淘汰、权重剪枝、投机解码）形式化为带显式假设的 Lean 证明图，并构建 AutoAssumption：放松其中一条假设，由 LLM 重新推导、重新证明并生成代码，在淘汰与剪枝任务上均超过所运行的已发表方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 属 ML 系统算法自动发现，与视觉推理无直接关系；但其「显式假设—单点放松—重推导—形式化校验」的搜索与审计流程，可能可供核查用于搜索 latent 推理机制的设计假设、并分离各设计选择的贡献。
